title: InfraAtlas weekly brief
method: Fixed templates over the app's data files, no language model. Weekly mean = mean of the 15-minute day-ahead prices of the seven days (zones with prices in at least 95 % of the slots of both weeks). Outages, queues and US capacity are compared with the previous brief's stored figures.

templates.price_rise: The {rank}largest weekly rise in the mean day-ahead price was in {zone}: {prev} to {now} EUR/MWh ({delta:+} EUR/MWh).
templates.price_fall: The {rank}largest weekly fall in the mean day-ahead price was in {zone}: {prev} to {now} EUR/MWh ({delta:+} EUR/MWh).
templates.price_zones: {n} bidding zones had prices in at least {cov} % of the 15-minute slots of both weeks; the weekly mean is the mean of those prices.
templates.price_high: The highest 15-minute day-ahead price of the week was {eur} EUR/MWh in {zone} at {at}.
templates.price_low: The lowest 15-minute day-ahead price of the week was {eur} EUR/MWh in {zone} at {at}.
templates.above_year: {zone} went above its highest price of the period {p0} to {p1} ({old} EUR/MWh): {eur} EUR/MWh at {at}.
templates.below_year: {zone} went below its lowest price of the period {p0} to {p1} ({old} EUR/MWh): {eur} EUR/MWh at {at}.
templates.no_year_record: No zone went above its highest or below its lowest price of the period {p0} to {p1}.
templates.record: The week's highest EU {what} was {gw} GW on {day} (sum of the member states reporting{pct}); {verdict} ({n} days in the archive, {first} to {last}).
templates.no_change: No zone's weekly mean {dir} against the week before.
templates.offline_now: {mw} MW of generation was reported offline: {planned} MW planned and {forced} MW forced (sum of the units reporting).
templates.offline_change: The week before, the brief read {prev} MW offline ({delta:+} MW).
templates.queue_change: {market}: {active_delta:+} active requests and {mw_delta:+} MW since the previous brief (read {prev_read}).
templates.us_added: Plants in operation whose earliest unit of a fuel group entered service in {year} (EIA-860M points with coordinates): {mw} MW (sum of net summer capacity; largest: {list}).
templates.us_added_change: The previous brief, from the {prev_release} release, read {prev} MW ({delta:+} MW).
templates.eu_added: Operating units of at least 20 MW commissioned in {year}: {n} units, {mw} MW (sum; largest: {list}); {prev_year}: {prev_n} units, {prev_mw} MW.

sections.title: Day-ahead prices: this week against the week before

sentences.text: 43 bidding zones had prices in at least 95 % of the 15-minute slots of both weeks; the weekly mean is the mean of those prices.
sentences.source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, A44 day-ahead prices, the app's day archive
